dateFrom.title: Modified since
dateFrom.description: Only tenders modified on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: 1 day before the run. The Prozorro feed is ordered by modification time, so this is the main way to limit how much is scanned.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Case-insensitive words or phrases. A tender matches if ANY keyword appears in its title or item descriptions. Ukrainian and English both work (titles are usually Ukrainian).

cpvPrefixes.title: CPV / ДК 021 code prefixes
cpvPrefixes.description: Keep tenders whose items have a classification code starting with any of these prefixes, e.g. "30" (computers), "33" (medical), "45" (construction), "72" (IT services).

regions.title: Buyer regions
regions.description: Substring match on the buyer's address region, e.g. "Київ", "Львівська". Leave empty for all of Ukraine.

statuses.title: Tender statuses
statuses.description: Prozorro statuses to keep. Common: active.enquiries, active.tendering, active.auction, active.qualification, active.awarded, complete, cancelled, unsuccessful.

procurementMethodTypes.title: Procurement method types
procurementMethodTypes.description: Optional filter, e.g. aboveThreshold, belowThreshold, reporting, negotiation, priceQuotation. Leave empty for all.

minValue.title: Minimum expected value (UAH)
minValue.description: Skip tenders with an expected value below this amount.

maxValue.title: Maximum expected value (UAH)
maxValue.description: Skip tenders with an expected value above this amount.

maxItems.title: Max tenders to output
maxItems.description: Stop after this many matching tenders have been saved.

maxScanned.title: Max tenders to scan
maxScanned.description: Safety limit on how many tender records are fetched from the feed (each one is an API request). Raise it for wide date ranges.

includeDocuments.title: Include document links
includeDocuments.description: Add the list of tender documents (title, URL, format) to each record.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Parallel requests to the Prozorro API. 8 is safe; higher values may get rate-limited.
